postInstallationInstructions.description: Instructions to be displayed at the end of the installation process. Use it to explain the remaining tasks that cannot be automated.

settingsPaths.description: Contains a list of application settings mappings.

items.description: Defines a source-destination mapping of a resource located in the `/config/ubuntu` or `/config/windows` folder (as appropriate).

resourceName.description: The name of the file or directory.

destination.description: The destination path, it can be an absolute or relative path, although it is recommended to use an absolute path to avoid copying resources to unwanted locations.

completionCommands.description: Commands to execute after copying the resource.

items.description: Contains a list of command arguments, e.g: ["echo", "Hello World!"]

postInstallationInstructions.description: Instructions to be displayed at the end of the installation process. Use it to explain the remaining tasks that cannot be automated.

vscodeExtensions.description: Contains a list of VSCode extensions to install.

gitConfiguration.description: Git configuration. If a `.gitconfig` file exists in `/config/ubuntu`, it will be used as the base configuration and the changes described in this object will be applied to it; if any configuration collides, the configuration defined in this object will prevail.

email.description: The email to show in the commits, e.g. 'johndoe@example.com'.

userName.description: The name to show in the commits, e.g. 'John Doe'.

quickAccessFolders.description: Contains a list of folders to create and add to the quick access section of the file explorer.
